# `vmafx/score.h`

Frame scores, pooled scores and windows.

`#include <vmafx/score.h>`.

## Structs

### `VmafxScore`

One score and the extractor that produced it. Size 40 bytes, alignment 8. Since 0.1.

| Field | C declaration | Offset | Since | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `struct_size` | `uint32_t struct_size` | 0 | 0.1 | Size of this struct as the caller compiled it; set by the _INIT macro. |
| `backend` | `uint32_t backend` | 4 | 0.1 | Backend of the producing extractor (CPU when none is registered). Values: `VmafxBackend`. |
| `index` | `uint64_t index` | 8 | 0.1 | Frame index. |
| `value` | `double value` | 16 | 0.1 | Score. |
| `feature` | `const char *feature` | 24 | 0.1 | Feature name as requested. |
| `extractor` | `const char *extractor` | 32 | 0.1 | Registered extractor that declares the feature, or NULL (imported scores, option-decorated names until WP5). |

Initialise with `VMAFX_SCORE_INIT`.
